description:
ESET Endpoint Antivirus is a complete security solution produced from our long-term effort to combine maximum protection and a minimal system footprint.

ESET Endpoint Antivirus represents a new approach to truly integrated computer security. The most recent version of the ESET LiveGrid® scanning engine utilizes speed and precision to keep your computer safe. The result is an intelligent system that is constantly alert for attacks and malicious software endangering your computer.
ESET Endpoint Antivirus is a complete security solution based on the long-term effort to combine maximum protection and a minimal system footprint. The advanced technologies, based on artificial intelligence, can proactively eliminate infiltration by viruses, spyware, trojan horses, worms, adware, rootkits, and other internet-borne attacks without hindering system performance or disrupting your computer.
ESET Endpoint Antivirus is primarily designed for workstations in a business environment.
- New: Support for Browser Security extension
- New: Support for Browser Security - Secure Search
- New: Support for Browser Security - Website Security Inspector
- New: Support for Browser Security - AI Conversation Security
- New: Backup management added for Ransomware Remediation feature
- New: Added Georgian language
- New: Extended RMM API support for Terms of use approval
- Improved: Audit log now records manual log deletion
- Improved: Audit log now records manual restoration of a file from Quarantine
- Improved: Proxy configuration from PAC files
- Changed: The default file hashing algorithm is now SHA-256
- Fixed: Wrong Time Stamp format in email from notification forwarded to email
- Fixed: Active directory user authentication for Override mode
